text:
maria: @vikram escalating on behalf of AcmeRetail. They report streaming responses closing early and lots of partial outputs. Happens consistently in production when clients are deployed behind Vercel/Edge. Screenshot + token ids attached in the ticket. :rotating_light:

maria: Error pattern: stream starts, a few events arrive, then the connection drops. Client sees reconnect and sometimes gets a 401 on the follow-up request (auth header apparently missing intermittently). Other times they see 200 but no more events. They say it started after they turned on an ALB in front of their origin.

sam: adding context from CS — customer on Dedicated plan, high volume, very sensitive to stream gaps. They reported spikes in tail-latency around the same time. Billing hasn't shown anomalies yet.

vikram: can you paste a raw repro (curl) and any edge logs? Need to rule out proxy idle timeouts vs keepalive vs our server closing sockets.

maria: pasted curl they used:

```bash
curl -i -N 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" 
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=gpt-lite&stream=true"
```

maria: Relevant snippet from customer edge proxy logs (timestamps redacted):

```
[edge] conn_id=abcd1234 idle_time=60s client=1.2.3.4 upstream=10.0.0.5 action=terminate reason=idle_timeout
[edge] conn_id=abcd1234 upstream_status=0 bytes_sent=1024
```

jen: fwiw our runtime defaults to a 90s client inactivity grace; we send periodic comment pings (":heartbeat\n\n") every 45s by default on hosted. But if the ALB idle timeout is lower or the client/proxy buffers, they might still terminate. Also important: some clients (esp. serverless edge) re-issue requests without forwarding the Authorization header. That would explain 401 on reconnect.

vikram: got it. Two parallel failure modes then: 1) upstream closes conduit due to idle TTL and 2) client's reconnect losing auth. We should confirm which is happening for this customer.

maria: customer says they set ALB idle timeout to 60s based on infra team default. They didn't have explicit client comment ping.

sam: they pushed a quick change to increase ALB to 120s and reported the stream was more stable for ~30 minutes, then started failing again. So ALB change gave partial improvement.

jen: that points to intermittent OS/TCP keepalive behavior + proxy rewrites. Also note our runtime emits colon comments only when the runtime has an active worker loop — if the model stalls (long generation), comment pings may not be sent depending on batching. We need to make our heartbeat independent of token generation.

vikram: we should replicate with a staging Vercel/ALB setup. I'll spin a small repro using node-fetch behind an ALB. Can someone capture a tcpdump?

maria: attaching minimal Node repro from customer:

```js
// node SSE client
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'text/event-stream', Authorization: process.env.TOKEN } });
res.body.on('data', (chunk) => console.log('chunk', chunk.toString()));
res.body.on('end', () => console.log('end'));
```

maria: they said on reconnect their platform (vercel edge) re-issues the request but strips Authorization header.

vikram: that explains 401. For the partial outputs + silent kills, let's check: 1) ALB idle; 2) any intermediate proxy (CloudFront) buffering and closing; 3) TLS session renegotiation issues. Also, we should look at our idle-close logs: runtime logs show server initiated FIN after 120s of inactivity for conn=xyz at 2026-02-25T14:12:05Z.

jen: proposal: make server-side heartbeat unconditionally sent on connection socket every 30s as a colon comment, independent of model activity. Also emit a small EVENT: "ping" with id that clients can ack in subsequent request via Last-Event-ID header to detect missed reconnects.

sam: customer impact: low-latency but stable streams needed. Is there any billing implication for frequent pings? Small. We should document this — pings are tiny, not billable as token usage.

maria: support asked customer to enable ALB idle to 180s and to ensure their edge preserves Authorization on reconnects. Customer is testing that now.

vikram: quick triage plan:
- repro in staging behind same stack (Vercel -> CloudFront -> ALB -> origin) (owner: vikram)
- collect pcap and edge logs for failing sessions (owner: jen)
- add runtime flag to force unconditional comment-pings every 30s and short event ping id (owner: jen)
- add warning in docs about serverless edge kvs that strip auth on presigned reconnects (owner: sam)

maria: timeline: customer needs an interim workaround today. Can we provide client-side suggestion for immediate relief?

jen: Immediate mitigations to suggest:
- Set ALB idle timeout >= 120s (prefer 180s)
- Configure client to send periodic client-side comment pings (":client-ping\n\n") if they control client runtime
- Use sticky sessions/long-lived connections where possible
- On reconnect, include original Authorization and Last-Event-ID; implement retry policy if receive 401 and re-add auth

maria: shared a short copy-paste snippet for clients that can add comment pings in browsers:

```js
// browser SSE shim: send keepalive comments from the server, but if you control the client you can do a no-op fetch to keep proxies alive
setInterval(() => fetch('/_noop?keepalive=1', { credentials: 'include' }), 25_000);
```

sam: we also want a runbook: detect pattern where connection shows bytes_sent stagnation then FIN from edge; alert on repeated 401 on reconnects within a minute window.

vikram: followups:
- jen to open PR to emit unconditional pings and ping-id event (ETA EOD)
- vikram to produce repro and pcap, post results here (ETA tomorrow morning)
- sam to draft support doc and customer-facing mitigation steps (ETA EOD)
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime/heartbeat-patch -> canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC :shipit:

jen: one more caveat — comment pings may be swallowed by proxies that buffer until full response; colon comments are the most widely supported because they are ignored by the event-stream parser on the client but keep TCP active. We'll add both approaches in docs.

maria: customer confirmed ALB->180s improved stability for 2 hours; will watch overnight. If they still see auth-stripping on reconnect we'll ask them for a support capture.

sam: closing loop: if patch reduces failures we'll propagate new default heartbeat interval to hosted docs and make it configurable in Dedicated. Also add a small billing note that pings are not charged as tokens.

vikram: noted — also tracking an internal metric to surface repeated reconnects per API-key and unusual 401 spikes during reconnect windows. Want to catch broken edge rewrites early.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket with proposed mitigations and the customer's feedback.

jen: adding follow-up: need to ensure heartbeat emission is robust even when model worker is GC'ing or blocked — will implement at network layer rather than generation loop.

maria: tagging this as high priority for the customer (AcmeRetail). Will re-open if customer sees more regressions. :thumbsup:
